pr_body:
These methods are safe to call while the page is still open, or when it is
already closed. Works in remotely connected browser as well.

Also makes `video.path()` to throw for remotely connected browser.

Under the hood migrated Download and Video to use the common Artifact object.

Fixes #5853.

issue_context.title: [Feature] Redirect video stream to new path
issue_context.body:
Some of us run Playwright as test cases, e.g. via Jest using `it` statements and test files (suites). When using [the awesome videos functionality](https://playwright.dev/docs/videos) it saves one huge video in case the browser context never closes between tests.

It would be cool to have hooks to `page.video()` e.g. `page.video().path('some-path')` to redirect the buffer to a new file. It would also be cool if I can chose the file name of the video in those scenarios, as I might want to name them as the test case. (I can add a UUID or similar myself if wanted).
comments:
>> in case the browser context never closes between tests

The problem is this ^^, you should always create a new context for each test.

I would strongly encourage you to use context per test. The test can have several steps, but still context per story, not page per story. If you deviate from this strategy, it'll be increasingly hard to use Playwright long term - all our decisions are around isolation and efficiency.

I'm keeping this as a result for page.video().saveAs() though since it is orthogonal to the context discussion and makes sense!

@pavelfeldman Quick aside. In terms of e.g. Jest, do you consider the _test file_ or the `it`/`test` statement to have one context each? The later could be problematic with load times since you need to open a new context + page + loading the page, which could take time.

review_comments: If we move this up, there could be a race where another delete() happens during `await localPathAfterFinished()`.
I'm a little worried you just leaked all the contexts.
Sure, let's clear these videos in `BrowserContext._didCloseInternal` just in case.
Can we inherit / aggregate Download and Video from Artifact?
